units.source_text: 夕雾大将觉得今日之行，比参与御前大规模试演更加严肃，神色十分紧张。

en.t: General Yugiri felt that today's visit was even more solemn than taking part in the grand rehearsal before the emperor, and his expression was extremely tense.

units.source_text: 他身穿一件色彩鲜艳的常礼服，内外衣裳都熏了浓烈的衣香，衣袖更加香得厉害。

en.t: He wore a brightly colored formal court robe, and both his inner and outer garments had been deeply perfumed, with the sleeves giving off an especially powerful scent.

units.source_text: 来到三公主正殿前时，天色已黑。

en.t: By the time he arrived before the Third Princess's main hall, it was already dark.
The twilight was clear, quiet, and charming.

units.source_text: 梅花洁白无瑕，仿佛正在恋慕去年的残雪，疏影横斜，纷纷乱开。

en.t: The plum blossoms were pure white and flawless, as if yearning for last year's lingering snow, their sparse shadows slanting across as they bloomed in a lovely disorder.

units.source_text: 微风拂拂，把梅花之香和帘内飘来的美妙不可言喻的衣香吹成一气，竟可“诱导黄莺早日来”。

en.t: A gentle breeze stirred, blending the fragrance of the plum blossoms with the indescribably exquisite scent of robes drifting from within the blinds, enough, it seemed, to lure the golden orioles to come early.

units.source_text: 宫殿四周充满了氤氲佳气。

en.t: All around the palace, an auspicious fragrant haze filled the air.

units.source_text: 源氏把筝的一端拉出帘外来，对夕雾说道：“莫怪我唐突啊！

en.t: Genji drew one end of the koto out beyond the blinds and said to Yugiri, "Do not think me abrupt.

units.source_text: 你替我把这筝的弦线调整一下。

en.t: Please tune the strings of this koto for me.

units.source_text: 我不好把疏远的人叫到这里来，所以只得叫你了。”

en.t: I cannot very well call someone unfamiliar in here, so I had no choice but to ask you."

units.source_text: 夕雾毕恭毕敬地拿过筝来，态度谨慎小心，从容不迫。

en.t: Yugiri received the koto with the utmost respect, his manner careful, restrained, and perfectly composed.

units.source_text: 他把基音调整为壹越调之后，并不试弹乐曲，表示谦虚。

en.t: After setting the fundamental pitch to ichikotsucho, he showed his modesty by not trying out a piece.

units.source_text: 源氏说道：“弦线既然调整了，总得试奏一曲，否则太没风趣了。”

en.t: Genji said, "Now that the strings are tuned, you really must play a piece to try them, or it would be far too dull."

units.source_text: 夕雾装腔作势地答道：“儿子本事低微，不敢在今天这音乐会上班门弄斧。”

en.t: Yugiri answered with deliberate formality, "Your son has only poor skill and would not dare display his ignorance before such masters at today's concert."
Genji laughed and said, "That is a fair point.

units.source_text: 不过外间传说你不得参加女乐演奏，因而逃跑了，倒是名誉攸关啊！”

en.t: But people outside are saying that because you were not allowed to take part in the women's music performance, you ran away, and that is a matter touching your honor."

units.source_text: 夕雾便重整弦线，试弹了美妙的一曲，然后把筝奉还。

en.t: Yugiri then adjusted the strings once more, played a beautiful piece to test them, and respectfully returned the koto.

units.source_text: 源氏的几个孙子都作值宿打扮，非常可爱。

en.t: Several of Genji's grandsons were all dressed for night duty, and they looked very charming.

units.source_text: 他们吹笛伴奏弦乐，虽然还有稚气，却也非常美妙，显然是前程远大的。

en.t: They played flutes to accompany the strings, and although there was still something childish about them, the music was very lovely, making it clear that they had great promise.
